meta_description:
199 likes, 10 comments - kubbrasait on October 29, 2026: "I thought I’d visit India Design ID @indiadesignid ONE TIME. I went back for seconds and thirds 😅

Through the lovely, ridiculously energetic Matteo Cibic’s @matteocibic eyes and my own, I found art in nostalgia, culture, heritage and all the things that move us. I even made a friend for life after failing to recognise him at first. What a day. Had so much fun making this little vlog. Hope you have fun watching it too. 🤍

Thank You @aparnabadlani for 2 spectacular days and nights of dreaming after!!!

[India Design ID, India design, Indian designers, art and design, Matteo Cibic, design exhibition, creative inspiration]".
